messages.content: Return only the requested English text. Do not add a preface or word/token count.
Write a brief academic-style statement distinguishing a recorded interview from the memory of the event being described. Aim for approximately 28–44 English tokens.

message.content: A recorded interview constitutes a fixed, external artifact preserving specific utterances, whereas memory remains a dynamic, internal reconstruction subject to temporal decay and cognitive bias. Consequently, the former offers static evidentiary value, while the latter reflects fluid, subjective interpretation of past experiences.
